I answered Tobias in a thread on their message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket is **#8841**.

That number comes from #central-random on 13 Oct at 09:27, a channel Tobias is in. Hollis asked them about "Tobias's dealer account", and Tobias said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that they had flagged it on ticket #8841. Nothing in that message names the account. I linked it to Marrow Fieldworks because of a public Central handoffs digest. It describes Marrow Fieldworks as a dealer account, previously Pree's, that "changes hands on 5 Jan 2026". The link is a strong match, but it is an inference.

I also slightly overstated one point in my reply. I said the account "was handed over to you on 5 Jan", but the digest doesn't say who received it. Messages from later on call it Tobias's dealer account, so the claim is very likely right, but it isn't directly confirmed.

Earlier, in a direct message, Tobias guessed the ticket might "end up at OPS-7485" and asked me to keep that private. I didn't mention it, and I didn't use it as a ticket number.
